lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits; specifically, a prominent column of four large blobs is visible adjacent to the pectoral fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs on the anterior flank, creating a grid-like lattice of high-contrast nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature extends horizontally across the upper visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and deep shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct vermiculated pattern of high-intensity pixel lines is located in the region immediately dorsal to the gill slits.
